title: Kinase annotation for helminths
protocol: Download the Kinase domain models file from the Kinomer website.
Determine kinome-specific score thresholds by adjusting initial values until an hmmpfam search identifies all known _C._ _elegans_ kinases using the Kinomer allPK.hmm profile database.
Use hmmpfam with default settings to map user-provided gene protein sequences against the Kinomer models.
Annotate genes with 'hits' meeting the kinase class specific custom cutoffs as putative kinases of the given class.
